notes: Main session caught 2 previously tracked SheetsScrollRenderController2 dependency errors during repeated opens/theme changes; kept as H3-OBS01, not claimed fixed. Final clean acceptance session had zero page errors.

Properties are checked against the actual source metric address: after deselect/reselect quantity is appended after defects (C5 rather than C4). Early coordinate/initialization readings are not acceptance evidence.

Final structural acceptance copies the whole sheet through its corner header; counts verify physical rows/columns as well as source positions. Earlier source-only undo left an unused row; corrected and retested.
Structural callbacks now consume canonical physical mutation IDs only; command/confirm wrappers do not count as additional removals.
A test helper Escape closed an AntD modal and one dropdown had duplicate aria-live text. Those harness attempts were retargeted and not counted as product failures.
Data fixtures replace only source module responses in isolated contexts; data-version reload was verified, not a real production push API.
Final-source clean cycle rechecks template, preview, save/reopen, VTable, note/formula, units/condition, and 25x15 sheet dimensions.
